newsitem.title: CHINA: China wins $100 million Saudi telecom deal.
newsitem.headline: China wins $100 million Saudi telecom deal.

text.p: China National Electronics System Engineering Corp has won a $100 million subcontract for construction work on telecommunications network expansions in Saudi Arabia, an official of the Chinese company said.
The contract was signed between the Chinese company and a private Saudi firm, he said without identifying the firm.
The deal is part of a major network expansion in Saudi Arabia, mainly involving AT&T Corp of the United States, the Chinese official said on Thursday.
AT&T and Saudi Arabian embassy officials in Beijing were not immediately available to comment.
The Chinese company will handle engineering work for the project, building 2,000 telecommunication stations, the official said.
The projects are expected to start in July and take four to five years to complete. No further details were given.
